items.title: Email Campaign · : Annual Service (1-Year Anniversary)
items.preview:
**Audience:** 21 clients | 1-year post-install
**Priority:** ⭐⭐⭐ CRITICAL. Time-sensitive maintenance window
### Subject Lines
**Primary:**
`Your system turns 1 this week`
**Alternates:**
1. `12 months in: time for your annual`
2. `We're coming back (in a good way)`
3. `The one appointment your system needs`
4. `Chelsea, your Re-Ionator Pro Ultra is due`
### Preview Text
`One appointment. One hour. Keeps everything running the way it should for another year.`
### Email Body
---
**Subject:** Your system turns 1 this week
**Preview:** One appointment. One hour. Keeps everything running the way it should for another year.
---
Chelsea,
Your Re-Ionator Pro Ultra hit the 12-month mark this week.
That means it's time for the one service appointment your system needs each year: the annual checkup.
We'll come out, inspect everything, swap what needs swapping, test your water, and make sure you're still getting the results you paid for.
Takes about an hour. You walk away knowing the next 12 months are covered.
**[Book Your Annual Service →]**
If you've got questions (or you're not sure what day works best), just reply to this. I'll get you sorted.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
---
### Personalization Notes for Mailchimp Merge Tags
- Swap `Chelsea` for `*|FNAME|*`
- Swap `Re-Ionator Pro Ultra` for conditional logic:
 - If `system` field = `(not specified)` → `your ClearWave system`
 - Else → `your *|SYSTEM|*`
### Send Timing
**Tuesday, 9:00 AM ET**
Rationale: Mid-morning Tuesday = highest open rate day/hour per Mailchimp benchmarks. Maintenance email (not promo) = professional tone fits workday open.
### Expected Performance
| Metric | Forecast | Justification |
|--------|----------|---------------|
| **Open** | 52% | Time-sensitive + product-specific + "turns 1" = personal milestone. Above baseline (41%) because transactional trigger, not broadcast. |
| **Click** | 12% | Single CTA, clear action, no friction. Maintenance CTAs outperform educational/content CTAs 30:1 in service industries. |
| **Conversion** | 35; 45% | 7; 9 bookings from 21. Conservative: some will call instead of click, some will delay 1; 2 weeks but still book. Annual service is *expected* maintenance, not a cold upsell. |
### Source Justification
- **IDEA_SOURCING.md § Jobber Lifecycle Triggers** (annual service window)
- **Voice Fingerprint § Luxury Product Register**: short sentences, no hype, "the way it should" = engineered confidence
- **Hard Rules #2**: named the actual product (`Re-Ionator Pro Ultra`), used conditional for `(not specified)`
- **Hard Rules #3**: no review ask, no referral push (wrong lifecycle stage for referral)
---

items.title: Email Campaign · : Referral Push (30; 60 Days Post-Install)
items.preview:
**Audience:** 29 clients | satisfied, honeymoon window
**Priority:** ⭐⭐ HIGH. Highest referral conversion window + no recent referral campaign in Mailchimp log
### Subject Lines
**Primary:**
`The $500 question`
**Alternates:**
1. `Know anyone still buying bottled water?`
2. `We'll pay you $500 (seriously)`
3. `Your water's fixed. Want to help a friend?`
4. `James, quick favor?`
### Preview Text
`You send a friend. They get a free water assessment. You get $500 cash. Repeat as desired.`
### Email Body
---
**Subject:** The $500 question
**Preview:** You send a friend. They get a free water assessment. You get $500 cash. Repeat as desired.
---
James,
Quick question: know anyone in Gordonsville (or anywhere in Central VA) who's still dealing with bad water?
Here's the deal.
You send them my way. We do a free water assessment. If they move forward, you get **$500 cash**.
That's referrals 1 through 5 in a calendar year. Referrals 6; 9 pay **$750**. Referral 10 and beyond pay **$1,000**.
Even if they just book the consult but don't move forward, you still get a **$50 gift card** for the introduction.
No limit. No fine print. Just: send a friend, we'll take care of them the same way we took care of you, and you get paid.
**[Send a Referral →]**
(Or just reply with their name and number. I'll take it from there.)
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
---
### Personalization Notes for Mailchimp Merge Tags
- Swap `James` for `*|FNAME|*`
- Swap `Gordonsville` for `*|CITY|*` (or fallback: `your area`)
- Link `[Send a Referral →]` to: **clearwaveva.com/refer** (or Jobber referral form if live)
### Send Timing
**Thursday, 11:00 AM ET**
Rationale: Later in week = weekend plans forming = social/conversational mindset. Referral asks perform better Thursday/Friday per HubSpot referral-email benchmarks. 11 AM = post-morning-rush, pre-lunch.
### Expected Performance
| Metric | Forecast | Justification |
|--------|----------|---------------|
| **Open** | 48% | Curiosity subject line (`The $500 question`) + short = high open. Slightly above baseline because sent to recent, satisfied clients (recency = higher engagement). |
| **Click** | 8% | Referral emails underperform content emails on click (no immediate personal benefit = lower urgency), but clear $ incentive + simple CTA will drive above Mailchimp avg (0.33%). |
| **Conversion** | 10; 15% | 3; 4 referrals submitted from 29. Realistic: not everyone knows someone ready *right now*, but 30; 60d post-install = peak satisfaction + top-of-mind. Even 3 referrals = potential $1,500 revenue if 1 closes. |
### Source Justification
- **IDEA_SOURCING.md § Jobber Lifecycle Triggers** (30; 60 day referral window)
- **IDEA_SOURCING.md § Competitive Intelligence** (implied: ClearWave's referral program is a differentiator; most competitors don't formalize/promote it)
- **Hard Rules #3 + #3a**: pushed referral (not review), used exact bonus structure ($500/$750/$1,000 + $50 gift card), used "free water assessment" phrase
- **Voice Fingerprint § Luxury Product Register**: "we'll take care of them the same way we took care of you" = service promise, not transactional. Parallel structure. Minimal contractions.
- **Hard Rules #5**: zero em dashes, used periods and parentheses for asides
---
## Why These 2 (and Not the Others)
| Candidate | Why NOT This Week |
|-----------|-------------------|
| **RO replacement** | 25 candidates, but RO membranes last 2; 3 years (not 6 months). Mailchimp shows zero filter/maintenance emails recently, so annual service takes priority. RO can wait 2 weeks. |
| **Concierge upsell** | 100 candidates = big audience, BUT: (1) Mailchimp baseline click = 0.33%, so educational/upsell emails are currently underperforming, (2) Concierge is a *consideration* purchase (not urgent), (3) annual service + referral are both time-sensitive + transactional = higher ROI this week. Concierge is the right campaign for NEXT week after we rebuild engagement. |
| **Cold lead re-engagement** | 1,000 cold leads = huge opportunity, BUT: these are top-of-funnel, low-intent. Require a multi-touch sequence (not one-off broadcast). Better as a 3-email drip starting next week, not a single campaign competing with high-intent transactional sends. |
---
**Recommendation:** Send both. They target non-overlapping audiences (annual service = May 2025 installs; referral = March/April 2026 installs) and serve different goals (retention vs. acquisition). Total send volume = 50 emails. Low fatigue risk, high conversion potential.
